::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 16th [1867]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Historical Society of Pennsylvania: Gratz Collection: Case 10, Box 36. British Authors
:::

My dear [Mrs Donkin](people/person_441.qmd),
As soon as may be I will get the [Summer Vacation](other_books/otherbook_505.qmd) sent to the press, but it cannot be before October at soonest that I send it - as all these remarkable events have thrown other M S back. I have a Naval Review just come, to complete the series you began.

By the by, it was a Woolwich cadet’s uniform that [prince Arthur](people/person_1997.qmd) wore - as the [daughter](people/person_1520.qmd) of the late [commandant](people/person_1521.qmd) specially begged me to observe. I wonder whether the Prince will criticise it too.

I was not sure enough where you were to send you the proofs, as there was no time to spend in their wanderings

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Unidentified. ‘The naval review’, by A sailor’s daughter, had appeared in *MP* in September.
